changelog: Scrolls overflowing feed grids while keeping the matchup header fixed and card/header sizes unchanged. Two to four feeds retain the original layout. Preserves the selected feed and scroll position during refreshes and when returning from playback. Retains selection when feeds reorder; if the selected feed disappears, focus moves to the nearest remaining feed. Keeps focused cards and their glow fully visible with the TV remote; phones and tablets can swipe the grid.
